name: Bluesy sax stabs
desc: A playful, staccato vcsl saxophone spitting bluesy licks over C (blue notes eb/f#/bb) with a constant slightly-flat detune for worn tape character, short and wet in a tight dub echo. Sparse trades one stab per cycle across the rests; full plays a syncopated four-bar lick; peak rips a fast call-and-response run with a phrase-end double-time fill. Late-night neon and a smirk — the opposite of the dream sax.

code.full: note("<[c5 eb5 ~ f5] [f#5 g5 ~ f5] [eb5 c5 ~ bb4] [g5 f5 ~ eb5]>").add(note(${root})).add(note(-${det})).s("sax_stacc").attack(.01).release(.18).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(2).off(1/8,x=>x.gain(${gain}*.4)).gain(${gain}).room(.35).delay("${dly}:0.375:0.5").pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[c5 eb5 f5 f#5 g5 f5 eb5 c5] [g5 bb5 c6 bb5 g5 f5 eb5 f5] [c6 bb5 g5 f5 f#5 g5 bb5 c6] [eb5 f5 g5 bb5 c6 g5 eb5 c5]>").add(note(${root})).add(note(-${det})).s("sax_stacc").attack(.01).release(.14).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.6).slow(12)).lpq(2).off(1/8,x=>x.add(note(-12)).gain(${gain}*.35)).gain(${gain}).room(.35).delay("${dly}:0.25:0.55").every(4,x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(5).play()
